title.narrative: Development of new administrative guidelines for grants to Danida Fellowship Centre

description.narrative: The overall objective of the assignment is to develop a set of connected collaboration agreements/administrative guidelines for the cooperation between MFA and DFC. The overarching collaboration agreement and the underlying guidelines must take their starting point in the current agreements and guidelines, but must collect, harmonise where possible, and clarify these into one related complex of guidelines. Concerning guidelines for a pooled funding model for development research, these must be developed from scratch, taking inspiration from other pooled funds guidelines. An additional objective is to make recommendations for the transition phase between the current administrative set-up for development research projects and the future pooled funds set-up.
